name: TooltipPreview
description: A static tooltip bubble for documentation and screenshots. Same classes, no behaviour.
signature: ({ content, shortcut, side }: { content: ReactNode; shortcut?: string; side?: "top" | "bottom"; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: content
props.description: The bubble's text: a control's name or why it is disabled.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: A keyboard shortcut drawn after the text in keycaps ("mod+k").

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the (imagined) trigger the bubble sits on; the arrow points back at it. Defaults to `"top"`.
